calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.store_weeks, ly.store_weeks AS ly_store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
    SELECT business_date, store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS net FROM net_lines
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1,2
), ctl AS (
    SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales AS ctl_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
    WHERE store_id < 900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, COUNT(*) AS store_days, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(m.net,0)),2) AS mine, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(c.ctl_net,0)),2) AS ctl,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(m.net,0)) - SUM(COALESCE(c.ctl_net,0)),2) AS gap,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.net,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl_net,0))>0.05) AS bad_store_days
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c USING (business_date, store_id)
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = COALESCE(m.business_date, c.business_date)
WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'dup_sales_lines' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(c-1) AS extra FROM (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-21' AND DATE '2026-09-06' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', COUNT(*), SUM(c-1) FROM (
  SELECT sales_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-21' AND DATE '2026-09-06' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_return_lines', COUNT(*), SUM(c-1) FROM (
  SELECT return_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_return_line
  WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-21' AND DATE '2026-09-06' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stores_current_multiple_versions', COUNT(*), 0 FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'current_physical_stores', COUNT(*), 0 FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stores_with_dates:' || store_id || ' ' || store_name || ' open=' || COALESCE(CAST(open_date AS VARCHAR),'null') || ' close=' || COALESCE(CAST(close_date AS VARCHAR),'null'), 1, 0
FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900 AND (open_date IS NOT NULL OR close_date IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closures:' || store_id || ' ' || closure_type || ' ' || closure_start_date || ' ' || closure_end_date, weeks_closed, 0 FROM ref_store_closure
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ref_fiscal:' || fiscal_period_label || ' ' || period_start_date || ' ' || period_end_date || ' loaded=' || fully_loaded, weeks_in_period, 0 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period=4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT net_amount) amts, COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) prods, COUNT(DISTINCT store_key) stores,
         COUNT(DISTINCT quantity) qtys, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, MIN(sale_date) sd, MIN(etl_loaded_at) l1, MAX(etl_loaded_at) l2, MIN(sales_line_id) id1, MAX(sales_line_id) id2
  FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-21' AND DATE '2026-09-06'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_week, COUNT(*) AS dup_keys, SUM(CASE WHEN amts=1 AND prods=1 AND stores=1 AND qtys=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identical_content,
       MIN(l1) AS first_load, MAX(l2) AS last_load, SUM(CASE WHEN loads>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_load_ts, MIN(id2-id1) AS min_id_gap, MAX(id2-id1) AS max_id_gap
FROM d JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = d.sd
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), w AS (
  SELECT n.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net, COUNT(DISTINCT n.business_date) AS days
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
  GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT t.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, t.fiscal_week, t.net AS ty, l.net AS ly, ROUND(100.0*(t.net/l.net-1),1) AS g, t.days AS ty_days, l.days AS ly_days
FROM w t LEFT JOIN w l ON l.store_id=t.store_id AND l.fiscal_week=t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=t.store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE t.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND (l.net IS NULL OR ABS(t.net/l.net-1) > 0.25 OR t.days<>l.days OR t.days < 7)
ORDER BY 1,4

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, params.fiscal_period AS fiscal_period,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS lfl_net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS lfl_net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM params
JOIN lfl_sales ty ON ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
